round1_issues_resolved.v2ohftov2hf_constant_fold: Correct. When the i32 operand is a ConstantSDNode, each lane is converted with APFloat BFloat -> IEEEhalf, rmNearestTiesToEven; a NaN lane gives 0x7e00. That equals fcvt.h.s of the exactly widened f32, which the exhaustive runtime test shows the hardware does. New test tc.c: 600 compile-time-constant bf16 lanes (every exponent class incl. subnormal, overflow-to-inf boundary, RNE tie mantissas, NaNs of both signs with payloads) plus the same constants through v2hftov2ohf. At -O2 the v2ohftov2hf calls are folded (no fcvt in the object for them); the results equal GAP9 GCC -O0 on GVSoC at every level (GCC -O2 ICEs on constant conversions). Constants that appear only after combining (select of equal constants, (x&0)|K, a const-array load, x*0+K; logs/20-F042-rev2/gv/late.c) all fold to 0x7e007e00 at O1/O2/Oz, so the payload-keeping generic fold is not reached.
